candidate.title: QQQ EMA cross filtered by ADX trend strength [ideas:harvest-classic-wilder-adx-di]
candidate.one_line: From Ideas `harvest-classic-wilder-adx-di`. Trade fast/26 EMA crosses only when ADX(14) exceeds a threshold; reverse on opposite signal; 0.5% stop. Source: J. Welles Wilder (1978), New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems (ADX).

sources.title: Ideas registry: Wilder ADX + DI trend system
sources.creator: Ideas feeder (OVH)
sources.claim: +DI crosses above −DI and ADX(14) rising above 25 → long; reverse when −DI > +DI with ADX strong. Exit/flat when ADX rolls over below ~20 (trendless). Classic New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems.

failure_theory: ADX lags; entries may come late.
Costs and next-bar fills may erase a published gross edge.

setup: QQQ regular session 09:30-16:00 ET on 1m bars; signals use completed bars and fill at the next bar open.
long_entry: Fast EMA crosses above EMA(26) with ADX above threshold, 10:00-15:30.

exits.time_exit: Flat by 15:55 ET; no overnight position.

short_entry: Crosses below with ADX above threshold.

candidate_specific_checks: Evaluate only the predeclared grid; no expansion after seeing results.

exclusions: No paper/live trading or automatic promotion.
